text:
harper_sales: Quick heads-up Prospect (Silverline Bank) has two gating asks before they sign: (1) BYO-KMS with HSM-proxy in their VPC, and emergency rotation so new writes use new keys within 3 minutes; (2) invoice must show per-HSM-call lines for internal chargeback. Can the team confirm feasibility and sample SOW wording?

neha_se: Clarifying q: is the 3-minute requirement for new writes only, or do they need full propagation/revocation across caches in 3m? That matters for our runbook.

harper_sales: They said new writes must use rotated keys within 3 minutes. Reads for historical data can continue for 24-48h. They also want invoice CSV export with per-route HSM-call counts.

caleb_eng: Technically achievable with coordinated steps: rotate in customer KMS -> push wrapping key to HSM proxy fleet -> RPC cache invalidation -> optionally rotate session certs to force TLS renegotiation. Forced invalidation will likely cause a short spike in errors and elevated tail latency while clients reconnect. I'll produce a latency/error matrix for 20/200/1k rps.

toni_sre: Runbook (high-level): 1) customer triggers rotation 2) Redwood pushes key to proxies 3) issue cache-invalidate + warm new key 4) optionally rotate session certs to force new handshakes 5) cut traffic to new key 6) monitor error rate and rollback threshold. Emergency path: skip canary -> immediate invalidation. Recommend documenting expected transient error window (30-90s) in SOW.

anika_security: Security checklist: need customer's KMS attestation, HSM vendor certs/attestation, and whether they require a split-import ceremony (M-of-N). If they want FIPS 140-2 Level 3 or on-site ceremony, add lead time and a line item. Also rotation events must have signed audit logs and retention policy. Link (internal): https://redwood.internal/sec/byo-kms.

oscar_finance: Billing: we can expose SKU BYO_HSM_CALL and surface per-call lines; engineering must emit metering tags per proxied request. For CSV, we can add a per-route breakdown as a separate export. What price did they propose?

harper_sales: They floated $0.006/call and asked for discounts above 1.5M calls/mo. They want the HSM-call line visible on invoice and in CSV.

caleb_eng: Cost sanity: $0.006 at scale is tight but doable with a commit. Latency: if HSM unwrap is per-request expect +100-300ms depending on region and connection reuse. With warm caches and pooling we can hit 95th ~100-150ms. Forced invalidation worst-case error spike ~0.5-2% for 30-90s.

toni_sre: Networking: prefer VPC peering or PrivateLink over NAT for predictable egress. Firewall: allow outbound 443 to proxy IPs and ephemeral ports for responses. Starter TF snippet I usually share:```tf
resource "aws_vpc_peering_connection" "peer" {
  vpc_id = var.customer_vpc
  peer_vpc_id = var.redwood_vpc
}
```

anika_security: SOW draft snippet: "Redwood will use commercially reasonable efforts to begin serving new write requests encrypted with newly-rotated keys within three (3) minutes of rotation initiation. Emergency revocation may require forced cache invalidation and TLS session renegotiation which can cause transient elevated error rates; Redwood will provide signed rotation audit artifacts upon Customer request. Exceptions include network partitions, force majeure, and Customer misconfiguration." If customer insists on a firm SLA propose a measurable target such as "95% of new write requests in Customer's primary region will use new keys within 3 minutes" and include measurement method.

oscar_finance: For pricing I'd propose a tiered table: $0.0085/call for <500k, $0.006 for 500k-1.5M, $0.0045 for >1.5M with option for a monthly commit to drop to $0.0035. We can also add a line for "attestation & ceremony" as a one-time fee.

harper_sales: OK. Next steps: (1) Caleb -> latency + error matrix for forced vs staged rotation at 20/200/1k rps (2) Toni -> network template + peering vs NAT pros/cons (3) Anika -> exact doc checklist and attestation examples to request from customer (4) Oscar -> draft tiered pricing + sample invoice + CSV schema. I'll schedule a 20m call with Silverline after we have these.

meter-bot: Note: per-call metering for BYO-KMS is tracked under feature flag feature/per-call-metering-byo-kms. PR #5403 adds metering tags to proxy path. Staging rollout ETA: 72h.

caleb_eng: I'll post numbers in ~24h. Initial expectation: forced-evict path hits error delta ~0.5-1.5%, additional latency tail for 60-90s.

anika_security: I'll DM Harper the checklist and sample attestation PDFs (and note ceremony lead times).

toni_sre: I'll attach network templates and recommended firewall rules in the follow-up. Prefer peering for stability.

oscar_finance: I'll mock an invoice + CSV extract template once PR is in staging. If legal wants a measurable SLA we need to define metric name, aggregation window, and region scope.

harper_sales: Thanks team 44d. Please flag any blockers here. I'll loop in solutions-legal once we have SOW + pricing.
